posts.name: Runthesis
posts.tagline: Let's find your trading thesis
posts.description: Runthesis is a multi-agent LLM trading framework that mimics how a real trading firm works. Different AI agents split the job fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts gather market data, then bullish and bearish researchers debate it to keep things balanced. A trader agent makes the call, risk managers check it's safe, and a fund manager gives final approval before execution.

posts.name: WealthStreet AI
posts.tagline: Practice Investing with AI
posts.description: WealthStreet pairs AI-powered chart analysis with a risk-free stocks and options trading simulator — built for anyone who wants to understand price action and practice trades before risking real capital. Snap a photo or upload any chart and get instant AI analysis: trend direction, key levels, and pattern recognition to help you read the chart like a pro. Then practice the trade — calls, puts, and strategies — using virtual money and real market data. Chat with the AI and plan your next trade!

posts.name: People Brief — Know who you’re meeting
posts.tagline: Know who you're meeting, before you meet them.
posts.description: People Brief researches public information about the person you're about to meet and turns it into a concise, source-backed brief. Know who they are, what matters, what to ask, and what not to assume — before an interview, investor meeting, client call, or first conversation. People Brief is not a meeting recorder or calendar assistant. It researches the person before the conversation starts.

posts.name: The Life Dashboard
posts.tagline: Your family's day, always on the wall
posts.description: A touchscreen on the fridge that a local AI agent keeps current: today's schedule, the weather, the one email that actually needs you, the week ahead, family photos. The agent lives on the same Raspberry Pi, has its own phone number, texts you before meetings, and answers when you text back. It runs on your existing ChatGPT account.

posts.name: Simple Health — AI Health
posts.tagline: Your health in plain words.
posts.description: Apple Health, minus the guesswork. Simple Health tells you what your numbers actually mean, in plain words, on your iPhone, Apple Watch, and home screen. Coming soon to the App Store.

posts.name: Little Brush: Coloring Game
posts.tagline: Kids Coloring and Drawing Game
posts.description: Kids Coloring App is a fun and easy painting app for toddlers and young children. Kids can color cute animals, vehicles, nature scenes, dinosaurs, and many other fun pictures while learning and being creative. The app includes simple drawing tools, bright colors, stickers, and a kid-friendly interface designed for little hands. Children can draw, paint, color, and save their artwork to enjoy later.

posts.name: Flowral
posts.tagline: Visual project planning with dependency-aware flows.

posts.name: YouTube Comment Picker
posts.tagline: Randomly pick a YouTube comment winner for fair giveaways.
posts.description: Use this YouTube comment picker to pick random winners from YouTube video or Shorts comments. Filter duplicates, keywords, dates, likes, and export winners.

posts.name: Down Is Forever
posts.tagline: One-touch endless faller. Dodge, collect Echoes, go deeper.
posts.description: Down Is Forever is a one-touch endless falling arcade set in a dark mindscape. Hold left or right to steer the shaft, dodge hazards, bank Echoes, and chase Daily Descent on the leaderboard—plus story cases that unlock as you go deeper. What stands out: offline-first play, no ads, no forced online, and a Descent Protocol framing that makes every run feel like digging for a root memory. Free on Google Play; iOS coming soon. Every case has a truth. No mind has a floor.

posts.name: ThreadPort
posts.tagline: Move AI chats between ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini in one click
posts.description: Every AI is good at different things — but your conversation is trapped in one. ThreadPort transfers the chat you're in right now to another AI with full context. No servers, no account, works in the EU. Free for 10 transfers/month. Chrome & Edge.

posts.name: Brainmox
posts.tagline: The AI agent that actually knows you.
posts.description: BrainMox is a local-first AI agent with persistent memory, real identity, and cross-channel continuity. It remembers your context across every conversation, so you never start from scratch again.

posts.name: Myndel
posts.tagline: The simplest digital loyalty card for local businesses
posts.description: The simplest way for a local business to run a loyalty program. Customers don't download anything, they just get a card on their phone. Setup takes 10 minutes. After that automated emails bring people back. Built for cafés, salons, barbers and gyms.

posts.name: Plotrecap
posts.tagline: Catch up on any book, spoiler-free.
posts.description: Forgot what happened? Plotrecap rebuilds the story so far: recap, character map, world rules and an illustrated map, stopping exactly where you stopped reading.

posts.name: Kin Health
posts.tagline: Record doctor visits and get clear summaries
posts.description: Kin helps you prepare for healthcare appointments, capture the conversation, and follow through afterward so you can stay present during the visit instead of taking notes or trying to remember everything later. After each visit, Kin turns the conversation into a focused summary. Rather than giving you a word-for-word transcript, Kin organizes the key points, recommendations, and next steps so you can quickly understand what happened and what to do next.

posts.name: ArloUI
posts.tagline: Beautiful mobile UI components, built for the AI era.
posts.description: ArloUI is an open-source mobile UI library built for both designers and AI coding agents. It gives you a carefully crafted set of reusable mobile components, patterns, and screens that can be used directly in React Native while making it easier for AI agents to generate interfaces that actually look good. Instead of starting from blank screens or generic components, give your agent a real mobile design system to build with. ArloUI is free and open-source.

posts.name: whocodedmore
posts.tagline: Your AI usage is drinking the planet. See how much.
posts.description: Developers like to boast about their achievements. Now there is a metric. (actually, there's a number.) npx whocodedmore@latest will read off your computer how many lines of code, tokens spent in Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex and another 20+ platforms you have written or spent on creating software, which will be converted into liters of water consumed, and you will be able to see your live ranking on the leaderboard. One command see how high you can climb on the world leaderboard.

posts.name: HomeAI Design
posts.tagline: AI facade redesign from a single house photo
posts.description: HomeAI Design turns a single house photo into AI-generated exterior renovation concepts. Upload a photo, choose a style, and compare realistic facade makeover ideas in seconds. New users get free trial credits to try it before upgrading.

posts.name: ScreenshotDeleter

Keep it and it lands in a clean gallery you can browse and copy from — never touch Finder again. $15 once, yours forever.

posts.name: VoltPilot
posts.tagline: Run your electrical business from one place
posts.description: Everything an electrical company runs on, in one tool: CRM, quotes, invoicing, jobs, scheduling and technicians. An AI assistant drafts quotes from your own price book. 39 euros a month, VAT included. Built and hosted in the EU.

posts.name: Insta360 X6
posts.tagline: A 360 camera, gimbal, and 3D scanner in one
posts.description: Insta360 X6 is a flagship 8K 360 camera with dual 1/1.1" Sony sensors, 8K50 video, 10-bit color, 140 minutes of 8K30 recording, and built-in storage. Its new PanoMind model and AI Director can find highlights, choose angles, and turn 360 footage into ready-to-share clips.

posts.name: Perch
posts.tagline: Net worth tracking that proves you're getting ahead
posts.description: Perch is a simple tool that helps you capture the monthly value of your assets and liabilities, with the purpose of tracking your net worth over time and highlighting progress towards your goal. It doesn't focus on budgeting or stock tracking; so it doesn't require linking bank or brokerage accounts. Monthly snapshots can be done in-app using a ready-to-fill form. You can see detailed graphs showing your net worth over time, asset/liability distributions, and individual account performance.

posts.name: Preflight
posts.tagline: A preflight checklist for product decisions.
posts.description: Preflight is an AI skill that helps product teams make better decisions before investing engineering time. Instead of jumping from problem → solution, Preflight helps teams validate whether they are solving the right problem, evaluate evidence behind decisions, compare solutions and understand risks before rollout. Built as a reusable AI skill for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Preflight does not replace product judgement. It helps teams ask better questions and make more informed decisions.

posts.name: Pixerate
posts.tagline: Creative process, without all the process
posts.description: Pixerate helps art directors iterate, explore and experiment with images, colors and concepts, at the speed of light.

posts.name: Numerical Solver

posts.description: Numerical Solver brings practical numerical computing to your phone. Solve equations, differentiate functions, integrate numerically, plot functions and data, and solve ODEs and boundary-value problems. Built for students, engineers, scientists, and anyone who works with numerical methods.

posts.name: Small Business AI Prompt Toolkit
posts.tagline: 200 AI prompts to run every part of your small business
posts.description: I kept rewriting the same messages for my own small business - product descriptions, review replies, invoice reminders - so I built this to stop starting from scratch every time. 200 ChatGPT & Claude prompts across 7 categories: planning, product copy, marketing, sales, customer service, HR, and finance. 51-page PDF, clickable table of contents, instant download.

Through one MCP, Claude, Cursor and Copilot get your whole system, every token, component and rule and how it's used, so they can build new things that actually fit your design system instead of guessing. That's far more than a raw Figma connection gives them. And once the code is written, Contexxt checks it against that same system too.

posts.name: TinyToolboxes
posts.tagline: Boring single-purpose tools that just work — no signup
posts.description: A growing set of tiny, single-purpose tools that each do one job and load instantly — JSON formatter, Base64, Unix timestamp converter, meta-tag preview, colour palettes, UUID and Lorem Ipsum generators, QR and password generators, and more. No login, everything runs in your browser.

Webround is already a reference for italian businesses that sell online, collect leads, and integrate data with external software.

No prompt engineering, no templates. Paste your content, hit generate, and get five ready-to-copy drafts adapted to each platform's tone and length. Free to start, 3 generations/month.

posts.name: Oasis

Every conversation, decision, and artifact becomes shared knowledge that compounds over time. As the workspace learns how you work, it adapts to your needs and builds specialized tools that help everyone do its best work.

posts.description: Vendor questionnaires used to take a full day. Sometimes two. VendorSafe turns that into minutes. Upload a PDF, Word, Excel, or pasted questionnaire. It offers a frame-precise multi-track timeline with keyframe animation, color grading, chroma key, and captions, and fully offline MP4 export. No downloads, no accounts, no subscriptions, no watermarks. Projects and media stay in IndexedDB, making Viko the privacy-first choice for creators.

Whether you’re launching a new business, modernizing existing operations, or looking to grow online, Cloudiqo works with you to turn your ideas into practical, scalable digital solutions.

A shortcut drops it in when you need it, before a deploy, a demo, an interview. No AI, no account, no subscription, nothing collected. Pay once, and new charms arrive in free updates.

posts.name: fline
posts.tagline: Your agent ships the repo. We build it and run it.
posts.description: Connect your coding agent over MCP and it ships your repo. fline writes the Dockerfile and the compose, picks the ports, provisions managed Postgres or Valkey, and hands back a URL already serving. The work happens outside your agent's context, so the deploy does not eat the session you were using to build. Secret values never pass through the agent: it declares the variable names, gets a link, and hands it to you unopened. Private beta, one node, and a maintained list of what does not work.

No source code ever leaves your machine.

posts.name: Tood

Just a compatibility score you can actually make sense of. Started in Lisbon, open globally.
